sources.title: Boone City Council proceedings of 19 October 2026: site plan and MOU approval
sources.summary: Council unanimously approves the named Boone Edge Colocation Facility site plan at 1920 Lakewood Drive and a Lightedge MOU that outlines a future development agreement. This establishes the public named proposal and planning action. It does not report a building permit, site mobilization, or construction. Relevant passage is on PDF page 1.

sources.title: Boone 19 October 2026 council packet: site plan and combined Lakewood Drive parcels
sources.summary: Council staff review identifies the proposal at 1920 Lakewood Drive, combining 1920, 1940 and 2000 Lakewood Drive: Boone Business Park lots 7, 6 and 5. Attached county reports identify parcels 088326032082011, 088326032082010 and 088326032082009. Submitted plan C100/C101/C200 identifies Edge Boone LLC/Edge BCC LLC and the same property. It describes commercial colocation, cloud and managed IT services in two staged buildings. Proposed MOU terms contemplate a future development agreement at application for construction permits. Floor-area descriptions conflict across the packet and minutes and are omitted from admitted metrics.
sources.date_semantics: City document-center entry 2724 was posted 16 October for the 19 October meeting. Plan sheets are dated 6 October 2026 and survey 1 September 2026. All are proposal/design context, not evidence of achieved construction.
